title: Robotics & Embodied AI
businessQuestion: When do general-purpose humanoid actuators achieve payback against human wage parity?
investorQuestion: Which hardware subsystem (actuators, harmonics, sensors, vision-language-action models) holds pricing power?
overview: Records span industrial automation through humanoids, with a growing cluster at pilot stage. Hardware maturity runs ahead of software generalisation: the companies to watch are those selling actuators, sensors and manipulation stacks into existing plants rather than promising general-purpose labour. Deployment evidence, not demo footage, is the differentiator.
